about_the_game: The production project for "The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ♡-40 and more..."—the remastered edition of the romantic adventure game "The Prince of Tennis School Festival"—is officially underway!! The original work was released in December 2005 as "The Prince of Tennis School Festival"—affectionately known as "Gakupuri"—, its sequel "The Prince of Tennis Motto School Festival -More Sweet Edition-" followed five years later in 2010. Now, in celebration of Gakupuri's 20th anniversary, the long-awaited remastered version is coming to Steam! This beloved romance adventure game lets you enjoy romantic interactions with characters from The Prince of Tennis! The remastered edition retains fan-favorite features such as fully voiced scenarios and romanceable characters, while introducing newly drawn still illustrations exclusive to this release. You can choose to view nostalgic stills from the original version or explore newly illustrated scenes in the remastered edition—switch freely between both styles to suit your preference. Stay tuned for upcoming announcements including the release date, feature details, and a newly illustrated key visual.
